experiment: New prospective contract: M7R on windows-amd-host, a second AMD Vulkan host (AMD proprietary driver on Windows). The candidate patch is the frozen amd-host receipt, unchanged, applied to cb7e56ecd. The acceptance rule is copied unchanged from reports/benchmarks/amd-vulkan/20261029-dropin-phase/round4/frozen-m7r2.json; pair count differs (96, from this host's own timing budget, not a power simulation). This is separate evidence for the owner's c-direct decision, not a rerun of any amd-host contract.

host.label: windows-amd-host
host.gpu: AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics, integrated RDNA2, vendor 0x1002 device 0x1681
host.loader: Vulkan loader 1.4.309 (System32 vulkan-1.dll); a second ICD (Microsoft Dozen, vulkan_dzn.dll) fails vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices with -3 on this host; implicit layers: AMD switchable graphics, Steam fossilize, Steam overlay
host.memory: heap 0 11.42 GiB DEVICE_LOCAL, heap 1 5.71 GiB system, heap 2 256 MiB DEVICE_LOCAL (host-visible window); 16 memory types

candidate: cb7e56ecd + reports/benchmarks/amd-vulkan/20261029-dropin-phase/round3/m7r.patch (sha256 441f1828b399616877b4358351e83ae3ebdf53158792162ce04e6427a900afbd); the patch applies without conflict

providers.main: Doe C at cb7e56ecd (Windows SDK clang-cl build, Vulkan owner), webgpu_doe_c.dll
providers.dawn: Dawn d04f88359 Release, MSVC, monolithic SHARED, Vulkan + Null only, DAWN_FORCE_SYSTEM_COMPONENT_LOAD=ON

sampling.orders: all permutations of 4 providers, cycled (96 is a multiple of their count)
sampling.inputs: frozen inputs; manifest afe4e1d3... (byte-identical to the amd-host and intel-host manifests), independent CPU oracle on every iteration outside the timed interval

metric: complete = compileNs + pipelineNs + resourcesNs + sum of every iteration's operation interval + teardownNs (CPU oracle excluded). Paired ratios per balanced pair; bootstrap 95% CI, 10000 resamples, seed 20261029. Host clock: QueryPerformanceCounter.

acceptance.dispatchWorkloads: vector and image: complete CI95 upper < 1.0 AND warm.submit CI95 upper < 1.0
acceptance.phaseGuard: no warm phase on any workload with ratio CI95 lower > 1.05
acceptance.verdict: pass only if every workload window is valid and dispatchWorkloads, uploadReadbackBound and phaseGuard all hold

validity.perWindowGate: Each workload runs in its own window under the shared GPU lock directory (mkdir/rmdir, held only for the window). Before any harness starts, a 15 s pre-window sample under the lock must show all GPU engine time, including System (PID 4), <= 2% and foreign CPU <= 5%. During the window: foreign GPU <= 2% of wall time, where foreign = PDH 'GPU Engine(*)\Utilization Percentage' summed per engine (max engine per 1 s sample, averaged) for processes whose image is neither harness-*.exe nor System (PID 4). System GPU time is WDDM video-memory paging/zeroing done for every process; it is 0.0% idle and about 7.5% on the Copy engine while harness processes run (diag/tool-check-3), so it is recorded as systemGpuPct and excluded from foreign during the window. Foreign CPU <= 5% of window CPU capacity (wall x 16 logical CPUs): GetSystemTimes busy minus the window tree (window script, cohort process, every harness child by GetProcessTimes). Zero failed processes and zero oracle misses. A/A: dawn-aa/dawn warm.operation median within [0.95,1.05] with CI95 containing 1, on every workload.
validity.windowsBackground: Background processes are left running and are measured, not stopped: two idle codex.exe daemons, a node process and a desktop app belong to other owners. Windows Search indexing and Defender scanning are counted as foreign CPU; a 60 s idle probe after they settled measured foreign CPU 0.22% and GPU 0.0% (diag/idle-probe-2).
validity.invalidWindows: An invalid window is rerun fresh under the unchanged contract, up to 4 attempts per workload; invalid data are retained and never used or reinterpreted.
